info.name: CampusKart MERN API
info.description:
All 67 CampusKart operations. Start the API with `npm start` in backend/ and import this collection.

Login once: Postman stores the HttpOnly ck_session cookie for every later request. Use the demo accounts in the project README, or register a new student with the multipart request.
